name: Scale Wipe Slideshow
description: Full-screen image slideshow where slides swap with a horizontal scaleX wipe, driven by wheel, touch drag, or round arrow buttons.
contents: Scroll hint text with previous and next round arrow buttons
behavior: Current slide collapses horizontally while the next one expands from the opposite edge
Navigates on wheel, touch, pointer drag, or button click and loops around
Ignores input while a transition is running
Images are preloaded before the slideshow becomes visible
editableByProps: Transition duration, easing, wheel speed and tolerance
Navigation buttons visibility, size, colors and hint text

needsCodeEdit.where: scaleX tweens and transformOrigin values inside the navigate function
images.map block inside the slides grid

fixed: Takes over wheel, touch and pointer input on its own full-screen area through a GSAP Observer
Root is full-width and one screen tall
